# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite and m152** · Released September 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU bindings and updates the bundled renderer to Skia m152. The release also adds asynchronous GPU readback, restores Vulkan Silk.NET packages, and improves native asset and lifetime reliability across supported platforms.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated through milestone m152** — Updates the bundled rendering engine to Chrome milestone 152 and incorporates subsequent upstream stability and servicing fixes. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backends exposed** — Adds bindings for Graphite on Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, enabling applications to use Skia's newer GPU rendering architecture. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Asynchronous pixel readback added** — SKImage and SKSurface now offer backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels operations for GPU readback workflows. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **Vulkan Silk.NET support restored** — Restores the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package and its native package production for consumers using Silk.NET Vulkan integration. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel and iterator sources remain alive** — Prevents native use-after-free failures when using SKRegion span iterators and SKPixmap subset or transformation operations. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Failed raster image creation releases buffers** — Correctly releases CoTaskMem pixel buffers when SKImage.Create cannot create a raster image. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **Runtime effect resets release prior uniform buffers** — Resetting SKRuntimeEffectUniforms now disposes the previously allocated uniform buffer instead of retaining it. ([#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Managed hot paths allocate less** — Reduces unnecessary copying, boxing, reflection, and temporary strings in shaping, tag formatting, data saving, and runtime-effect lookups. ([#4690](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4690), [#4752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4752), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))
- **Binding output is reproducible** — Makes generated bindings deterministic across build platforms, improving consistency for consumers building SkiaSharp from source. ([#4612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4612))

## Platform

- **Native symbols and fonts improved** — Produces Apple native symbol packages and uses FreeType to provide font support on Nano Server. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846), [#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

Improves shaping performance by avoiding a defensive feature-array copy and fixes disposal of non-memory-backed stream assets used to create HarfBuzz blobs.
